name: Vortox
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.
interaction: Points at a player, who dies. Passively, all Townsfolk ability information is false. At dusk, if no execution happened that day, evil wins.
drunk_or_poisoned: The kill fails, Townsfolk information may be true, and a day without execution does not make evil win.

rulings.text: Townsfolk information is false even if that Townsfolk is drunk or poisoned.
Only Townsfolk ability information is affected; Storyteller rules explanations, character or alignment changes, and non-Townsfolk information (e.g. a Snake Charmer swap) are true.
Exiling a Traveller is not an execution.
A Savant learns two false statements each day.
